# Poppy Agent Playground

> Point a Personal Agent at any Poppy Company and drive the Personal Agent
> Protocol (Poppy) end to end — discovery, a signed-out Session, Direct Sign-In
> and consent on the Company's own page, and signed-in API calls — with every
> request decoded on the wire. Built by Authlete.

The Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy) lets an AI agent act for a user against a
"Company" (a website that exposes Poppy). The agent discovers the Company, holds
a per-request signed Session, signs the user in on the Company's own page, and
then calls the Company's APIs with the granted scopes. This playground is a
working Personal Agent you can drive against any Poppy Company to watch the whole
handshake.

## What it shows

- Discovery of a Company from its domain (the validated domain↔issuer binding).
- A signed-out Session, then Direct Sign-In + consent on the Company's own page.
- Signed-in API calls built from the Company's OpenAPI, with a ready-to-send body.
- A live wire log that decodes the Poppy-Session JWT and its delegation, the
  DPoP proof (RFC 9449), and the private_key_jwt client assertion.

## Identity

The agent self-hosts its own client identity as a CIMD (Client ID Metadata
Document) by default — the served URL is a usable `client_id` — or you can bring
your own from the UI. DPoP (sender-constrained tokens) is a UI toggle; it is
optional in Poppy draft 0.4.
